blocks.text: 权限

inlines.text: 权限

blocks.text: 权限分为三个级别：

inlines.text: 权限分为三个级别：
默认：
已安装的应用只能做它们在浏览器里能做的事。
应用权限：
应用可以申请使用 Claude 能严格控制的一些常见功能，比如创建置顶窗口、监听全局快捷键或发送通知。
完全电脑访问权限：
应用可以申请运行程序，以及读取、修改或删除你的文件，而无需每次都征求同意。

blocks.text: 你的授权只覆盖应用的当前版本，因此每次更新后 Claude 都会重新询问，即使更新是你自己做的编辑也一样。如果应用的某部分来自其他网站，那部分内容可能在 Claude 不再次询问的情况下发生变化。

inlines.text: 你的授权只覆盖应用的当前版本，因此每次更新后 Claude 都会重新询问，即使更新是你自己做的编辑也一样。如果应用的某部分来自其他网站，那部分内容可能在 Claude 不再次询问的情况下发生变化。

blocks.text: 你只能为你自己制作的应用授予完全访问权限；在 Team 和 Enterprise 中，只能为组织内成员制作的应用授予该权限。Anthropic 不会在你安装前审查应用，所以请只对你信任的应用授予完全访问权限。

blocks.text: Starting today, you can use Claude artifacts to create, run, and share desktop apps. The "Install as app" feature is rolling out in beta in Claude for Mac and Windows.

inlines.text: Starting today, you can use Claude artifacts to create, run, and share desktop apps. The "Install as app" feature is rolling out in beta in Claude for Mac and Windows.

blocks.text: When an artifact is installed as a Mac or Windows app, it gets its own icon and opens in its own window instead of inside Claude. You can share it with others, and it needs your permission before it can interact with your computer. You choose how much to allow.

blocks.text: Permissions

inlines.text: Permissions

blocks.text: There are three levels of permissions:

inlines.text: There are three levels of permissions:
Default:
Installed apps can only do what they’d be able to do in a browser.
App permissions:
Apps can ask to use common features that Claude can tightly control, like creating always-on-top windows, listening for global shortcuts, or sending notifications.
Full computer access:
Apps can ask to run programs and read, change, or delete your files without asking each time.

blocks.text: Your permission only covers the current version of the app, so Claude asks again after every update, even your own edits. If part of an app comes from another website, that part can change without Claude asking you again.

inlines.text: Your permission only covers the current version of the app, so Claude asks again after every update, even your own edits. If part of an app comes from another website, that part can change without Claude asking you again.

blocks.text: You can only give full access to apps you made or, on Team and Enterprise, apps made by people in your organization. Anthropic doesn’t review apps before you install them, so only give full access to apps you trust.

blocks.text: Getting started

inlines.text: Getting started

blocks.text: Describe your app to Claude, try it as an artifact, and then click "Install as app." You don’t have to package or sign it, and it uses your Claude account, so there’s no API key or separate login.

inlines.text: Describe your app to Claude, try it as an artifact, and then click "Install as app." You don’t have to package or sign it, and it uses your Claude account, so there’s no API key or separate login.

blocks.text: Install as app is rolling out in beta on all plans. HIPAA-ready organizations and hybrid deployments can’t use it. It’s on by default for Team, with full access off. On Enterprise, it’s off until an owner turns it on. You need to be online and signed in to Claude to open an app. Some artifacts can’t be installed, including Claude Docs, Slides, and Sheets.
